'''July 2001 Billings tournament (29 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG local (sealed deck, unsanctioned) held in Billings, Montana on 29 July 2001. [[Cody Custis]] won it. It is known from Cody Custis's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2808">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-08-wyoming-montana-july-26-28d2808/ wyoming-montana-july-26-28], DeckTech (Cody "blackgecko" Custis, 8 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-08-wyoming-montana-july-26-28d2808/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Billings, Montana
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 6
* '''Winner:''' [[Cody Custis]]
